description: The first round of the 2026 WNBA playoffs opened Sunday. Here's your one-stop shop for all the action.

headline: Zandalasini scores 22, leads Valkyries past Wings 104-80 in Game 1 of first- round playoff series
description: — Cecilia Zandalasini scored 22 points, Gabby Williams added 20, and the second-seeded Golden State Valkyries ran away from the Dallas Wings by halftime for a 104-80 win in the teams' playoff opener Sunday night.

headline: Howard, Reese help Dream rally from 11-point deficit, beat Mystics 92-77 in Game 1 of playoff series
description: — Rhyne Howard had 26 points and five steals, Angel Reese added 13 points and 12 rebounds in her first career playoff game, and the Atlanta Dream beat the Washington Mystics 92-77 Sunday night in Game 1 of their first-round series.

headline: A'ja Wilson, defending champion Aces dominate Fever in opener
description: The Aces rolled to a Game 1 victory as A'ja Wilson became the first player in any WNBA game to record 35 points and 15 rebounds while shooting 75% from the field.

headline: A'ja Wilson, Reese, Clark lead AP's WNBA award winners
description: A'ja Wilson is in a class by herself, winning the AP WNBA Player of the Year award for an unprecedented third straight season. Angel Reese dethroned Wilson as Defensive Player of the Year, and Caitlin Clark was named Comeback Player of the Year.

headline: Wings' Bueckers touts big-game experience ahead of WNBA playoffs
description: Wings star Paige Bueckers said her big-game experience, including winning an NCAA title at UConn and a gold medal in the FIBA World Cup, have prepared her for her first WNBA postseason.

headline: Fever's Ty Harris to miss playoffs due to broken left leg
description: Fever guard Ty Harris will miss the rest of the 2026 season after breaking a bone in her lower left leg, the team announced Saturday.
